source_preservation.openap: preserved as pinned corpus source and derived_exact 3-DOF product
source_preservation.jsbsim: preserved as pinned public approximation and rotational/control source

composition: OpenAP owns translational drag, target normal force, thrust, fuel flow, and scalar mass schedule.
JSBSim owns approximate alpha mapping, side force, moments, and control structure.
Taoryx owns actuator policy, stability augmentation, and estimated CG/inertia rescaling.
boundaries: No duplicated drag, thrust, or fuel contribution is permitted.
The model is not an upstream Airbus DAVE-ML package.
Generated DAVE-ML is canonical regenerated output, not source-preserving output.
